meta.title: Tecleo
meta.description: Real-time typing races against people and bots, in Spanish and English.

footer.credits: Texts from public domain works taken from <gutenberg>Project Gutenberg</gutenberg>. Word lists from <frequency>FrequencyWords</frequency> (CC BY-SA 4.0).

serverStatus.offline: Can't reach the server. Practice still works.

home.tagline: Type real texts, see your mistakes as you make them, and race against people or bots.

practice.name: Free practice
practice.description: By time, by word count or with a full text. No account and no connection needed.

bots.name: Against bots
bots.description: Up to five bots with a human rhythm, from beginner to legend.

public.name: Public race
public.description: Join an open room in your language; bots fill the empty spots.

private.name: Private room
private.description: Share a six-letter code and play with whoever you want.

ghost.name: Ghost
ghost.description: Race the replay of your best run or someone else's.

daily.name: Daily challenge
daily.description: The same text for everyone all day, with its own leaderboard.

targeted.name: Targeted practice
targeted.description: Drills built from the keys and letter pairs you miss the most.

practice.title: Practice
practice.loadError: The text couldn't be loaded. Reload the page to try again.
practice.mobileNotice: Use a physical keyboard to type comfortably.

typing.focusOverlay: Click or press any key to continue

results.title: Results
results.ignoreAccentsNote: With “ignore accents” on, this result doesn't count for leaderboards.

settings.title: Settings
settings.savedLocally: Changes are saved in this browser right away.
settings.preview: This is how the text looks while you type.

typingModes.free: Free: space moves to the next word even with mistakes
typingModes.strict: Strict: fix mistakes before moving on

settings.ignoreAccentsHint: Accepts “a” for “á” and “n” for “ñ”. Results don't count for leaderboards.
settings.showLiveStats: Show wpm and accuracy while typing
settings.focusModeHint: Hides everything but the text while you type.
settings.keyboardLayoutHint: Used to draw the keys you miss the most.

race.title: Races
race.description: Race against bots or other people on a track where your type block is the runner.

room.title: Room {code}
room.description: Private rooms let you pick the language, text, bots and player count, and ask for a rematch without leaving.

leaderboards.title: Leaderboards
leaderboards.description: The best validated results of the day, the week and all time, by language and mode.

profile.title: {nickname}'s profile
profile.description: Your wpm over time, race history, weak-key map, achievements and replays.

auth.nicknameHint: 3 to 20 letters, numbers, hyphens or underscores.
auth.unavailable: Accounts aren't active yet. You can play everything without one.

notFound.title: This page doesn't exist
notFound.description: Check the address or go back home.
